title: A Course in Hardened Wards
summary: A course that packs the plain ward into a harder shape and teaches the student to cleanse a mild taint through it.

title: The Treatise on Turned Blows
summary: A treatise on slanted and spinning wards that carry a strike off its line and send a thrown thing back.

title: The Handbook of Tended Wounds
summary: A handbook for those who stand over the hurt and teaches how a ward holds a wound closed while the qi mends it.

title: A Canon of Linked Guards
summary: A canon of wards that join two or more students so that one guard carries the load of the group.

title: The Workbook of the Standing Pair
summary: A workbook for two students who stand back to back and cover each other's turning side.

title: A Treatise on Borne Shocks
summary: A treatise on taking the full weight of a heavy blow into a packed ward and sinking it into the stance.

title: The Course of Shared Shields
summary: A course in passing a part of the student's own ward to a companion and in guarding a small company at once.

title: A Canon of Layered Strength
summary: A short canon that builds the ward in layers and teaches which layer to give up first when the pressure is too great.
